title: user.created.v1
description: Kafka topic user.created.v1 (key = user_id, .DLT). Published by authService through its transactional outbox, consumed by userService. The consumer is create-only: insert if absent, else no-op, so a stale event can never overwrite PUT /user/v1/me edits. Producers must not add fields (additionalProperties: false).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Anything other than 1 is non-retryable for consumers.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event (outbox row id).

user_id.description: The new user's id (JWT sub). Also the Kafka record key.

created_at.description: When the user was created (RFC 3339 date-time).
